about: Plant photos the iPhone store capture uploads to the store-demo household (frontend/scripts/store-shots/photos/). They are screenshot fixtures only: no app build, seed or user data includes them. Each is one photographer's own work from Wikimedia Commons, public domain or CC0, so none needs a credit. The license was read on the Commons file page, and the original's SHA-1 matched the one Commons publishes. Every file was cropped to a square, resized to 800 x 800, re-encoded as JPEG and had its metadata removed.

photos.author: Judgefloro
photos.licenseQuote: I, the copyright holder of this work, hereby publish it under the following license: This file is made available under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication.
photos.changes: Cropped to a square on the central leaf (so no other plant, pot label or shelf is in frame), resized to 800 x 800, re-encoded as JPEG, metadata removed.
photos.identification: Commons category "Monstera deliciosa in the Philippines". A potted plant at an indoor plant display; the crop shows its broad leaf with the long marginal splits and the perforations of M. deliciosa.
